title: Prompt Robustness Is Task-Dependent: Comparing Objective and Belief-Style Questions in LLM Evaluation
reasoning: The paper investigates the prompt robustness of LLMs when evaluated on 'belief-style' subjective questions. It explicitly uses datasets like ValueBench and the World Values Survey to measure how stably models express societal values, beliefs, and political orientations, which ties directly to the evaluation of value systems and ethics.
